75 Ideas for a Rustic Wedding

By

Kristen Klein
Photo: Rikki Snyder Photography and Osiris Photo & Film
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:15
Instaread

Barn weddings have never been more popular, but you don’t need to hold your wedding on a farm to get a rustic vibe. Here are some of our favorite ideas for a country-inspired celebration.

1.Printed dresses — with pockets! — are the perfect level of formality for the occasion. Photo: Jennifer Weems Photography
2.This color palette fits in perfectly at a country wedding. Photo: Town and Country Studios
3.Cowboy boots don't have to be brown; stand out by wearing a jewel tone. Photo: A Guy + A Girl Photography
4.A country man is never fully dressed without a cowboy hat. Photo: Christian Oth Studio
5.Dress down your bridal party with cowboy boots and jeans; make your groom stand out by adding a blazer. Photo: Brandy Angel Photography
6.Sunflowers are a cheerful choice; add some lavender for contrast. Photo: Town and Country Studios
7.The rustic bouquet is purposely imperfect. Choose an arrangement that looks like you could've plucked it right out of the garden. Photo: Casey Durgin Photography
8.Shades of white combined with loose greenery reflect the more laid-back vibe of a rustic wedding. Photo: Two One Photography
9.A bold arrangement of wildflowers lends rustic appeal. Photo: Kathleen Hertel Photography
10.Fun photo op — place your bouquets in your cowboy boots! Photo: Jennifer Weems Photography
11.Complete your groom's look with a succulent boutonnière combined with twigs and fresh leaves. Photo Stephanie N. Baker Photography
12.Keep the stems of your wildflowers loose for a more relaxed vibe. Photo: Three Nails Photography
13.Instead of bouquets, give each bridesmaid a mini vase of baby's breath in a twine-wrapped Mason jar to carry down the aisle. Photo: Andie Freeman Photography
14.Top your cake with a twine ball. Photo: Andres Valenzuela Photography
15.From the etched-in initials to the lovebird cake topper, this tree-inspired cake is a rustic dream. Photo: Blue Dahlia Photography
16.Wrap your cake with burlap, and top it with a vintage-inspired silhouette. Photo: Amy Aiello Photography
17.This pumpkin patch-inspired cake is especially fun for a fall wedding. Photo: Ace Photography
18.Deconstruct your cake and display individual tiers on multi-leveled tree trunk cake stands. Photo: Joshua McCoy Photography
19.Display your dessert options on tree trunks. Photo: Abby Rose Photo
20.A tiered cookie cake is a wonderfully homespun take on the classic wedding dessert. Photo: Brandy Angel Photography
21.Create a "cage" out of twigs, and decorate it with flowers, berries, and candles. Photo: Andie Freeman Photography
22.Raise your centerpieces above the table with towering branches, ferns, and moss. Photo: Mel Barlow
23.Add a pop of color to a burlap-wrapped vessel with a personalized ribbon. Photo: Crystal Image Photography
24.Stack burlap-wrapped Mason jars atop tree trunk slices. Photo: Brandy Angel Photography
25.Keep it simple with blue Mason jars and contrasting flowers. Photo: Claire Pacelli Photography
26.Encircle your arrangement of wildflowers and greenery with curved branches. Photo: Kristine Paulsen Photography
27.Top a wooden box with an eclectic mix of bottles wrapped in twine and burlap. Photo: Jennifer Weems Photography
28.Top your farm tables with flowers inside milk buckets. Photo: Michael Kaal Photography
29.Wine bottles repurposed as table numbers pop against the neutral hues of the burlap table cloth and tree stump centerpiece. Photo: Town and Country Studios
30.Place your centerpieces in cowboy boots instead of vases. Photo: Two One Photography
31.Nestle your rings in a bird's nest. Photo: Kathleen Hertel Photography
32.Greet your guests with a chalkboard wedding menu propped up by bales of hay. Photo: Amber Green Photography
33.Host your ceremony in front of an outdoor wedding chapel. Photo: POPography
34.Decorate your aisle with burlap, lace, and baby's breath. Photo: Claire Pacelli Photography
35.Tie your rings on a simple burlap pillow. Photo: Douglas Benedict Photography
36.Bring the outdoors in with an ivy-covered wooden ceremony arch. Photo: Andres Valenzuela Photography
37.A single silk flower surrounded by moss makes the perfect ring pillow. Photo: Andres Valenzuela Photography
38.Let your flower girl reflect your rustic vibe with a crown of ivy in her hair and a moss-covered basket to hold her petals. Photo: Elmer Escobar Photography
39.Give your flower girls a burlap-trimmed banner to introduce the bride. Photo: Town and Country Studios
40.Write each guest's name on a leaf. Photo: CLB Photography
41.Use pine cones to hold your guests' table assignments. Photo: Two One Photography
42.Attach your escort cards to cheerful billy balls, arranged in recycled wooden boxes topped with moss. Photo: Choco Studio
43.Frame yourselves with a heart made of branches. Photo: Two One Photography
44.Getting married on a farm? Take a stroll through the pastures. Photo: A Guy + A Girl Photography
45.A picture-perfect photo on top of a roll of hay.
46.Recreate the infamous American Gothic painting. Photo: POPography
47.Enjoy a quiet moment with your favorite animal. Photo: Stephanie N. Baker Photography
48.Write out a message on a tree slice. Photo: Amy Aiello Photography
49.Recreate a tranquil farm scene with your guest book. Photo: Andie Freeman Photography
50.Send each guest home with a handmade soap. Photo: Laura Hernandez Photography
51.Make a memorable exit with a wheelbarrow! Photo: Jessica Holley Photography
52.What could be more fun than going for a ride in a horse-drawn wagon? Photo: Orange Photographie
53.Paint a vintage pickup truck to match your wedding color palette. Photo: Andie Freeman Photography
54.Display quotes from your favorite country songs. This "Honey Bee" line is perfect for your bar! Photo: Shoreshotz Photography
55.Dress up a barn wedding with oversized chandeliers and dozens of strands of lights. Photo: Jason Qualls
56.End the night with a bonfire surrounded by your loved ones. Photo: Brandy Angel Photography
57.Hang your boots by the door before entering your reception. Photo: Brandy Angel Photography
58.Instead of a traditional vase, use a stack of terra-cotta pots adorned with moss. Photo: Evin Photography
59.Print some of your favorite engagement photos on canvases, and display them on antler photo stands. Photo: Jennifer Weems Photography
60.Let your guests know your wedding hashtag with a cute chalkboard sign decorated with burlap pendants. Photo: Crystal Satriano Photography
61.Point the way to your reception with a wooden sign. Photo: Michael Kaal Photography
62.Display your wedding desserts in a vintage farm wagon. Photo: Blue Dahlia Photography
63.Add your monogram to the barn's doors. Photo: Town and Country Studios
64.Long tables work perfectly in a barn setting. Instead of overpowering florals, line the tables with tree trunks, burlap, and mini arrangements of fresh flowers. Photo: Town and Country Studios
65.Wrap your cake cutting set in twine. Photo: Amy Aiello Photography
66.Photo: Andie Freeman Photography Utilize a vintage milk jug to hold your flowers.
67.Instead of glass or metal chargers, use a tree slice at each place setting. Photo: Cassie Jones Photography
68.Personalize your Mason jars to turn them into fun wedding keepsakes as well. Photo: A Guy + A Girl Photography
69.Transform Mason jars into cool lighting displays. Photo: A Guy + A Girl Photography
70.Pendant banners and icicle lights illuminate this barn wedding. Photo: Eric Vest Photography
71.Hang hand-painted tree slices on the chairs at your sweetheart table. Photo: Andie Freeman Photography
72.Transform Mason jars into homey wine glasses. Photo: Andie Freeman Photography
73.Draw the eyes up by decorating your ceiling with upside-down roses and fabric draping. Photo: Studio Eleven Photography
74.Instead of lighting a fire in the fireplace, place dozens of tree stumps and candles inside. Photo: Claire Pacelli Photography
75.Twinkling lights, candles, and branch centerpieces are all you need to create a rustic yet glamorous vibe. Photo: Rustic Wedding Chic
